data.name: ProviderConfirmRun
data.comment: {0} = result title. Inline confirm bar for a provider row marked ConfirmLaunch.

data.name: ProviderActionFailed
data.comment: {0} = result title. Shown on the error line when a provider action returns false.

data.name: ProviderActionError
data.comment: {0} = result title, {1} = exception message. Shown on the error line when a provider action throws.

data.name: SettingsUseWindowsAccent
data.comment: Settings page checkbox label; the panel accent follows the Windows accent color.

data.name: CalcSubtitle
data.comment: {0} = the expression as typed. Subtitle of the calculator row.

data.name: CalcSubtitleHex
data.comment: {0} = the expression as typed, {1} = the integer result in hex (e.g. 0x30). Subtitle of the calculator row.

data.name: SysCmdSubtitle
data.comment: Subtitle shared by all built-in system command rows.

data.name: SysCmdLock
data.comment: System command title: lock the PC.

data.name: SysCmdSignOut
data.comment: System command title: log off the current user.
